description: This file defines classes and enums related to functionalization in PyTorch, including ViewMeta and FunctionalStorageImpl, used for managing tensor views and storage mutations during the functionalization pass.

classes.name: ViewMeta
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing tensor view metadata during functionalization, including forward and reverse operations.

classes.name: FunctionalStorageImpl
classes.description: A subclass of StorageImpl that manages tensor storage mutations and views in the functionalization process, without underlying data.

methods.name: add_update
methods.description: Adds a new update to the functional storage, queuing mutations for later application.

methods.name: apply_updates
methods.description: Applies all queued updates to the storage, updating the base tensor.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Returns the base tensor associated with this functional storage.

methods.name: generation
methods.description: Returns the current generation counter indicating the state of mutations.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Freezes the storage to prevent further mutations.

methods.name: get_storage_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the storage before or after mutations.

methods.name: mark_mutation
methods.description: Increments the mutation counter, indicating a mutation has occurred.

methods.name: mark_mutation_during_no_grad_or_inference_mode
methods.description: Increments the counter for mutations during no_grad or inference mode.

methods.name: mark_mutation_hidden_from_autograd
methods.description: Increments the counter for mutations hidden from autograd.

methods.name: mark_inductor_storage_resize
methods.description: Marks that the storage has been resized by the inductor, updating size counters.

methods.name: was_inductor_storage_resized
methods.description: Checks if the storage was resized by the inductor.

methods.name: inductor_storage_resized_counter
methods.description: Returns the count of inductor storage resizes.
